name: The Boulevard
summary: The Boulevard is a community shopping center on Niagara Falls Boulevard in Tonawanda, NY, offering convenient access to retail, dining, and services for the northern Buffalo area. With a 4.1-star rating and over 2,100 reviews, it serves as a reliable shopping destination for local residents.
demographics: The Boulevard attracts a diverse middle-class demographic from the Tonawanda and North Buffalo areas, with a strong representation of families and working professionals aged 25-65. The trade area serves households with median incomes ranging from $50,000 to $85,000, drawing from both suburban neighborhoods and nearby urban communities. Shoppers typically visit for convenience-oriented purchases, combining grocery shopping with retail errands and dining. The center appeals to value-conscious consumers seeking national retailers and everyday services in an accessible location along the busy Niagara Falls Boulevard corridor.
description: The Boulevard is a well-established community shopping center located at 1551 Niagara Falls Boulevard in Tonawanda, New York, serving the northern Buffalo metropolitan area. Strategically positioned along one of the region's most heavily trafficked commercial corridors, this open-air center has become a convenient destination for residents seeking a mix of retail, dining, and service options. The center maintains a solid reputation with a 4.1-star rating from over 2,100 Google reviews, reflecting its consistent appeal to local shoppers. Operating daily from 9:00 AM to 9:00 PM, The Boulevard provides accessible shopping hours that accommodate working families and busy professionals throughout the week. As a community-oriented shopping destination, the center combines national retailers with local businesses, creating a practical shopping environment that meets the everyday needs of the surrounding neighborhoods in Tonawanda and North Buffalo.
